scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run deps && pnpm run changesets:check && pnpm run test && pnpm --filter @stardust/web run check
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && pnpm install --lockfile-only && biome format --write charts/stardust
scripts.test:db: test -n "$DATABASE_URL_TEST" || { echo "DATABASE_URL_TEST is not set: database tests need PostgreSQL (see CONTRIBUTING)"; exit 3; }; node --test "packages/*/src/**/*.dbtest.ts"
scripts.test:sops: test -n "$SOPS_BIN" -a -n "$AGE_KEYGEN" || { echo "SOPS_BIN and AGE_KEYGEN are not set: SOPS tests need sops and age-keygen (see CONTRIBUTING)"; exit 3; }; node --test "plugins/*/src/**/*.sopstest.ts"
